name: AReaL
summary: Apache-2.0 fully asynchronous reinforcement-learning framework for large reasoning models, with a public Python package and docs.
description: Open RL training system (areal-project/AReaL; not archived). GitHub and PyPI license Apache-2.0. PyPI package areal 1.0.4 and site https://areal-ai.io verified 2026-11-11. This is an established research/training framework, not presented as a brand-new hosted product launch. GPU clusters, model weights and any third-party rollouts are separate. English docs at https://areal-ai.io/docs/en/intro.html (the older areal-project.github.io documentation URL returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-11).

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install areal. Cluster and model setup follow upstream docs.
